purpose: Registry + intake gate for the standard-hull baseline fleet. Every record carries provenance (source/url/license/retrieval/verified) so a geometry file can be admitted only when its origin is stated and its sha256 is pinned.
honesty_note: This environment has no outbound network: no official IGES/offset file could be downloaded. Literature particulars below were entered offline (retrieval=offline_recollection, verified=false) and every derived or unrecalled displacement volume is marked basis=closure (Cb*L*B*T) instead of being presented as a published value. The gates and the ingest routes are the delivered capability; the digits are flagged, not laundered. Two geometry routes are used: 'series60_form' inside the Series-60 Cb window, and 'parametric_sections' (a generalized hull-surface surrogate solved to the published Cb, Cm and LCB) for the hulls the Series-60 law refuses. Neither route is the ship's official geometry: official IGES/offset files remain WITHHELD in this environment.
